card.title: Winner Sets the Terms
card.instruction: Carry yourself as though success gives you the right to define the next challenge, the reward, and what counts as fair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I won the bake-off, so next year's theme is cakes I already make.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You beat my lemon cake by half a point.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then lemon cakes clearly get a fair chance under my leadership.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. I'll enter that same cake again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Returning challengers must improve by a full point. The champion sets the standard.

mechanism: A uses winning to set future theme and then tailor the returning challenger's required improvement as the definition of fairness.
confusable: Unlike mere pride in success, A treats victory as authority to design the next contest's conditions.
comparison: The bake-off alternative imposes a higher threshold on the challenger; the bowling alternative expands the winner's authority into dinner and a new reward.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
